title: Music and Essential Oil in Agitation
brief_summary: The study aims to assess the effect of using music and essential oil on agitation in mechanically ventilated patients. Listening to classical relaxation music, and inhalation to bergamot oil will be used in this study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Agitation with RASS score +2 or more
* Mechanical ventilation
* Patients with GCS 13-15

Exclusion Criteria:

* Psychiatric illness
* Cognitive disorders
* Neurological disorder
* Hearing deficit
* Smelling deficit
* Respiratory asthma
* Allergic rhinitis
